title: Number of Citizens and Permanent Residents Unable to Pay MediShield Life Premiums
what_it_is: Number of Citizens and Permanent Residents Unable to Pay MediShield Life Premiums

sections.label: MediShield Life premium subsidies
sections.summary: The outstanding amount is $12.8 million, and the Government provides subsidies including transition, means-tested, Pioneer Generation and Additional Premium Support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The total amount outstanding is $12.8 million, or less than 1% of total premiums due.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Government has provided subsidies to help Singaporeans pay for their MediShield Life premiums.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These include transition subsidies, means-tested subsidies for lower- and middle-income households, as well as additional subsidies for the Pioneer Generation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Low-income Singaporeans who require financial assistance can apply for Additional Premium Support.

sections.label: Continuous premium payment outreach
sections.summary: Efforts to remind and help Singaporeans pay premiums will be continuous with the Central Provident Fund Board and other agencies, helping low-income Singaporeans via Additional Premium Support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Importantly, the efforts to reach out to remind and help Singaporeans pay for their premiums will be a continuous one that we will work together with the Central Provident Fund Board and other Government agencies on, and to help low-income Singaporeans who require financial assistance to also benefit from MediShield Life through Additional Premium Support.
